facts.fact: Chad's 2027 budget orientations say a standardised electronic transfer system will launch early in 2027, with all public entities paying beneficiaries exclusively electronically against standardised electronic invoices.

facts.fact: The 2027 budget orientations say tax, customs and Treasury systems are to be integrated with electronic payment solutions.
